stages.title: Foundations
stages.milestone: Compile and deploy a basic contract locally.

stages.title: Core language
stages.milestone: Build a task manager with access restrictions, state, errors, and events.

stages.title: Execution and application standards
stages.milestone: Use a standard-based contract and interact with it from a JavaScript application.

stages.title: Security and verification
stages.milestone: Demonstrate unit tests, fuzz tests, and a meaningful invariant.

stages.title: Production engineering
stages.milestone: Produce a tested, documented test-network deployment package.

stages.title: Advanced specialization
stages.milestone: Complete one specialist project and document trust, compatibility, and failure assumptions.

background_advice.path: Complete all stages; learn programming fundamentals and EVM basics without skipping.
Review Modules 1–3 quickly, then focus on data locations, transaction semantics, gas, and security.
Prioritize the language and EVM modules, then spend additional time on testing, security, upgradeability, and deployments.
Complete the language, EVM, interaction, and standards modules before specializing in defensive review.
